title: Equivariant Neural Operators for Incompressible Fluid Dynamics on Riemannian Manifolds
abstract: We present a geometric framework for operator learning on non-Euclidean geometries where vector fields are subject to continuous Lie group symmetries $G = \mathrm{SO}(3) \times \mathbb{R}^+$. By formulating kernel integral operators over manifold tangent bundles $TM$, we prove that the approximation error decays with $\mathcal{O}(N^{-1/d})$ under Sobolev norm $\|u - u_\theta\|_{H^s(M)}$. Extensive experiments on turbulent Navier-Stokes simulations demonstrate a $4.2\times$ speedup over traditional finite-volume solvers while preserving exact energy conservation laws $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}E(t) = -2\nu \Omega(t)$.

title: Provable Generalization Bounds for Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Neural Tangent Kernel Theory
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as an effective paradigm for solving non-linear partial differential equations. In this work, we analyze the training dynamics of PINNs under the infinite-width limit via the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) regime. We derive rigorous generalization bounds showing that the empirical residual error $\mathcal{R}_N(\theta)$ satisfies $\mathbb{E}[\mathcal{R}(u_\theta)] \le \mathcal{R}_N(u_\theta) + \mathcal{O}\left(\sqrt{\frac{\mathrm{Tr}(\mathbf{K}_{\infty})}{N}}\right)$ where $\mathbf{K}_\infty$ is the coupled NTK matrix incorporating boundary conditions.

title: Geometric Clifford Algebras for Deep Learning on Relativistic Spacetime
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)
abstract: We construct Clifford algebra valued neural networks invariant under Lorentz transformations $\mathrm{SO}^+(1,3)$. By embedding multivector representations $\psi \in \mathcal{C}\ell_{1,3}(\mathbb{R})$, our architecture natively handles 4-vector kinematics and electromagnetic field tensors $F^{\mu\nu}$ without requiring ad-hoc coordinate projections. Validated on high-energy particle physics datasets from CERN LHC.

title: Riemannian Gradient Flow and Loss Surface Curvature in Overparameterized Deep Models
abstract: We examine the Hessian eigenspectrum $\lambda_1 \ge \lambda_2 \ge \dots \ge \lambda_p$ along continuous Riemannian gradient descent trajectories. We show that the sharpness index $\lambda_{\max}(\nabla^2 \mathcal{L}(\mathbf{w}))$ exhibits a distinct phase transition at the edge of stability, providing practical regularization techniques for modern transformers.

title: Symplectic Neural Ordinary Differential Equations for Energy-Preserving Hamiltonian Dynamics
venue: SIAM Journal on Applied Dynamical Systems (SIADS)
abstract: Standard neural ODEs violate symplectic geometric structures when modeling conservative physical systems, leading to energy drift. We introduce Symplectic Continuous Normalizing Flows that parameterize the Hamiltonian vector field $X_H = J \nabla H(q, p)$ where $J = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & I \\ -I & 0 \end{pmatrix}$, ensuring long-term trajectory stability over $10^6$ integration steps.

title: On the Convergence of Stochastic Polyak Momentum on Non-Convex Variational Inequalities
abstract: We analyze stochastic heavy-ball momentum methods applied to non-monotone variational inequalities and min-max games $\min_{\mathbf{x}} \max_{\mathbf{y}} f(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{y})$. We establish an asymptotic convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{K})$ without requiring strong pseudo-monotonicity.
